node.title: Re^3: Parsing HTML/XML with Regular Expressions (XML::Twig)
node.author: Discipulus
node.doctext:
You presumed ~right about DATA filehandle.

The xmltwig.org and docs specify parse $string or \*OPEN_FILEHANDLE among twig's methods.

So you are right: I had to pass an handle not an iterator (?) like

I dunno when I took this bad habit but if you look at [id://1165274|this] and [id://1164406|this other one] and [id://1154473|this other too] and probably many others of mines, $twig->parse() works!!

So $twig->parse() does not works with your example but i can confirm that passing the filehandle $twig->parse(\*DATA) or even $twig->parse(*DATA) works as expected.

Can be that wrong form works (at least sometimes) because of the [METAMOD://XML::Twig] ability to parse streams of XML?

L*

There are no rules, there are no thumbs..
Reinvent the wheel, then learn The Wheel; may be one day you reinvent one of THE WHEELS.
